review_scope: Direct visual inspection of all 12 Poppler-rendered pages at 100 DPI plus independent PDF parser and outer-margin pixel checks
observations: Letter landscape and A4 portrait each contain six pages in two rows/three columns at 100 percent scale and 5 mm overlap
Footer page/grid order, fixed scale, whitespace separation and outer margins are correct; component/terminal/legend text remains readable at retained size
Artwork and labels deliberately cross tile seams; overlap retains assembly context. Letter page 3 contains only its footer because this stretched test circuit has sparse rectangular bounds
No unexpected ink outside printable margins, missing glyphs, footer collisions or distorted schematic symbols observed
limits: This is a fixed rectangular grid; sparse diagrams can produce blank or mostly empty tiles. Preview or smaller explicit scale can reduce paper use
No physical printer or universal readability/keyboard/accessibility qualification
